title: Swiss SME Websites 2026: 10,000 sites audited, canton by canton
description:
Aggregated measurements of 10,000 websites of Swiss small and medium-sized businesses, drawn at random from the Swiss commercial register (Zefix, via LINDAS open data) in September 2026. Measures: HTTPS, mobile viewport, structured data (JSON-LD), meta description, title length, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt, privacy page, footer copyright year, platform and HTML reception time, per canton, language region and legal form. Proportions only: no company name, no website address, no figure for a group of fewer than 30 sites.

Study page: https://hallebardier.com/en/swiss-sme-website-study/
